title: Whelgar's Excavation Site
wikitext:
[[Image:Whelgar's Excavation Site.jpg|thumb|Whelgar's Excavation Site]]
[[Whelgar's Excavation Site]] lies east of [[Menethil Harbor]] and southwest of [[Dun Modr]] in the [[Wetlands]].  Once a peaceful dwarven digsite, it has been taken over by mottled [[raptor]]s. A small group of [[dwarf|dwarves]] still carve out their living here, on a ridge overlooking the dig site.

== Questgivers ==
* [[Merrin Rockweaver]] - [[Quest:In Search of the Excavation Team]]
* [[Ormer Ironbraid]] - [[Quest:Ormer's Revenge (1)]], [[Quest:Ormer's Revenge (2)]], and [[Quest:Ormer's Revenge (3)]]
* [[Prospector Whelgar]] - [[Quest:Uncovering the Past]]
